newsitem.title: INDIA: India to compete with Asia by 2000 - Chidambaram.
newsitem.headline: India to compete with Asia by 2000 - Chidambaram.

text.p: Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that India's economy would be as competitive as that of any Asian country by 2000.
"India will Asianise herself and I vow that India will be as competitive as any Asian country by the year 2000," Chidambaram told a business conference in the Indian capital.
"The four years thereafter, India's tariffs, tax rates and investment climate will match any other country in the world," he said. "By 2005, India will take its place in the world."
